thread:
Evan Park: TL;DR from the postmortem: eviction cascade caused p99 spikes. Hotfix shipped but we need concrete owners, short timelines, and a trimmed triage playbook for oncall.
Nia Gomez: I'll take the playbook edits. Will make a 1-page triage checklist with explicit commands and the escalation ladder.
Ravi Shah: Please include the KV cache health checks and the lightweight diagnostic bundle we used. Quick pasteable cmds: 
```
kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=inference -o wide
POD=$(kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=inference -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}')
kubectl -n inference logs $POD -c inference --tail=250
curl -s localhost:9090/metrics | grep kv_cache_hit_ratio
```
Also capture kubelet eviction events: `journalctl -u kubelet | grep -i evict`
Hannah Lee: I'll lead remediation. Proposal: 48h spike for cache TTL + batch cap matrix, then a focused 10-day sprint to harden autoscaler and graceful degrade. Spike results due Thu EOD.
Evan Park: Escalation thresholds to land in the playbook:
- page @sre-oncall if >=3 pods evicted from same pool within 10m
- page @infra-lead if fallback route used >1x in 30m
- open INF ticket if user error-rate >0.5% for 10m
Nia Gomez: Adding canned Slack template and a minimal post-change validation checklist (p99, kv hit ratio, no evictions 30m).
Ravi Shah: I'll draft PromQL snippets to paste into the runbook for quick checks: 
```
sum(rate(kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{reason="OOMKilled"}[5m])) by (node)
sum(increase(kube_pod_status_phase{phase="Failed"}[10m]))
```
Pager Bot: Created INF-5347 "Eviction cascade: playbook + remediation" and assigned Hannah, Ravi, Nia.
Hannah Lee: Spike plan posted in INF-5347: TTLs=[15s,30s,60s], batch_caps=[48,56,64]; load tests Fri 09:00 PT. If a candidate reduces evictions with acceptable latency (<1% p99 bump) we propose it for sprint.
Evan Park: Also add a small synthetic that runs a representative prompt set against fallback route to monitor quality regressions. If quality drops >1% for two consecutive checks, page @ml-qc.
Nia Gomez: Runbook PR target: open by Fri EOD with triage steps, commands, PromQL, escalation paths, canned messages, rollback recipe.
Ravi Shah: After PR merges Ill add an automation that gathers the diagnostic bundle and posts it to the incident thread.
Hannah Lee: I'll create the sprint epic and break into subtasks: spike, canary autoscaler, alerts, runbook PR. Planning to kickoff Monday.
Evan Park: Action items summary for INF-5347: 1) Runbook PR (Nia) by Fri; 2) Spike + load test (Hannah) Fri 09:00; 3) Alert + synthetic (Ravi) next Wed; 4) Sprint kickoff (Hannah) next Mon. Calendar invite for Fri 11:30 PT check-in. :white_check_mark:
